items.title: NASA’s Hubble Uncovers Case of Missing Oxygen in Nearby Dwarf Galaxies
items.abstract: NASA’s Hubble studied 37 nearby dwarf galaxies and found that much of the oxygen they expected to see is missing.

items.title: Experiment supports theoretical foundation for potentially more error-resistant quantum computing
items.abstract: One approach to making information storage in quantum computing less prone to errors is known as topological quantum computing. It relies on special quantum states that are expected to be more resistant to local disturbances.
